text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle and I are about to head<n>back after a
day out.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, looks like it's fixin' to rain!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's just a quick shower, so it<n>shouldn't last long. I
duck under a<n>nearby roof for some shelter...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Got no umbrella, so there's<n>nothin' to do but
enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Runnin' in the rain is something else!<n>It's way
different from swimming in a<n>pool! It's more like...
runnin'<n>underwater!
choice_data_list: You're going to catch a cold!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Don't ya worry your pretty little head<n>about that!
See, I don't catch colds!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
choice_data_list: I'll just have to make you stop!
First one to the station wins!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that right? Ya wanna go,<n>Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Unable to match Taiki's sheer<n>strength, I just end
up getting soaked<n>as well.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day after that, she turns up at the<n>academy
feeling right as rain... I,<n>unfortunately, have a cold.
Haha! Just so ya know, I don't plan<n>on losin'!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
An energetic Taiki Shuttle goes<n>running off toward a
nearby building.
